Migrated css-lint to _languages/css/, gotmpl-fix+gotmpl-lint to go/, html-fix+html-lint to html/ autoload, updated NeoVim filetypes to use bin-zsh
Migrated python-fix, python-lint, python-test to _languages/python/ and toml-lint, fly-lint to toml/ autoload, updated NeoVim python.lua and toml.lua to use bin-zsh, moved existing tests
Migrated better-rm to misc/, kill-pid→process-kill and process-detach to system/process/, docker-image-list and docker-image-pull to docker/image/, moved better-rm tests to autoload location
